errors.name: CustomerNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a customer is referenced by an order but not found in the database.

errors.name: ProductNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a product is referenced in an order but not found in the database.

errors.name: OrderNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an order is referenced for cancellation or lookup but not found in the database.

errors.name: InvalidOrderStatusError
errors.description: Raised when an invalid order status is provided during order creation or cancellation.

errors.name: InsufficientStockError
errors.description: Raised when an order attempts to include a product with insufficient stock quantity.

errors.name: InvalidQuantityError
errors.description: Raised when a product quantity in an order is negative or zero.

errors.name: AtomicOperationFailedError
errors.description: Raised when an atomic transaction fails due to a database constraint or rollback during a modification operation.
